title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
Peter Solomon Ruma, a 37 year old Vero Beach man, was arrested and is being held on a $1 million bond. Police say he took photos from social media and other online sources to create and share AI generated sexually explicit images of women without their consent. Investigators searched his home and electronic devices on Wednesday and found evidence linking him to the images. Ruma faces eight charges tied to one female victim from June through August 2026, including three counts of creating altered sexual depictions, three counts of promoting those depictions, one count of sexual cyber harassment, and one count of stalking.

Police have identified several additional possible victims who may not know images of them were made or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. He has a prior criminal history, including a 2007 arrest for burglary and sex battery on a physically impaired person. The investigation is ongoing, and additional charges could be filed. Anyone who believes they were victimized or has information is urged to contact the Vero Beach Police Department.
